# origincloud Provider

Manages Origin Cloud resources.

Credentials come from the environment, the first of: `ORIGINCLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN`, an access token; `ORIGINCLOUD_CLIENT_ID` and `ORIGINCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET`, a service account; the session the `origin` CLI stored at its last `origin id login`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    origincloud = {
      source = "origincloudhq/origincloud"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials come from the environment, such as ORIGINCLOUD_CLIENT_ID and
# ORIGINCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET for a service account.
provider "origincloud" {
  region = "eu-central1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) The URL every call goes to instead, such as a test server's.
- `region` (String) The region whose front door the provider calls, such as `eu-central1`. Every front door serves every resource; a region only picks the nearest. Defaults to `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, and to the regionless endpoint when that is unset.
